description:
After other_carrier_questions: file the answers, passing answers_so_far back each time, until the set is complete.

Saves what the customer answered against their application. Once every required question has an answer the whole pass is filed, Sigo selects the cheapest of the other carriers, and a Sigo agent confirms the final offer with the customer. Send every answer under the code it came back with, and only what the customer actually said.

This shows no price and does not take payment, sign anything or bind coverage.

answers.description: What the customer said, in their own answers. Never filled in on their behalf.

code.description: The question's code, exactly as it came back.

answers_so_far.description: The `answers_so_far` from the previous call, when there was one: it carries what the customer already answered, so only the new answers need to go in `answers`.

locale.description: The language the customer is writing in. Set it from their own messages rather than leaving the default: the estimate's notice comes back in this language, and a notice the customer cannot read discloses nothing. Sigo serves these two languages only.

name: answer_other_carrier_questions

answered.description: How many of the carrier's questions have an answer so far, counting the earlier turns.

answers_so_far.description: Everything answered up to now, to pass back on the next call so nothing is lost. Null once the carrier has the set and there is nothing left to carry.

filed.description: True once the whole pass is filed and the cheapest of the other carriers is selected.

next_step.description: Paying and signing happen through the link, after an agent confirms.

note.description: What is done and what is still ahead, in the customer's language.

still_needed.description: The codes of the required questions with no answer yet. Empty when the set is complete.

title: File the customer's answers to the other carriers' questions
